_comment: Gemma3-MM SigLIP vision tower. `params` field name = the bound name the DSL / weights.json reference; `from` paths index the VERBATIM HF `Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration` config.json (the configs here carry it byte-for-byte). SigLIP uses a learned absolute pos-embed and no rope at all -> `vision_rope_half_dim = 0`. Reproduces the old `VisionFamily::Gemma3` derivation (keys hidden_size/num_hidden_layers/num_attention_heads/num_channels; temporal/merge absent -> default 1; pool chain off image_size / mm_tokens_per_image; d_model = text_config.hidden_size). ORDER MATTERS: `expr` entries read bounds that earlier entries defined. SigLIP block norms read `vision_config.layer_norm_eps`, which is 1e-6 for every gemma3 checkpoint — the parse default (1e-6) already matches, so no `vision_norm_eps` is declared. `scale_dtype` governs ONLY the MM projector's `mm_soft_emb_norm` (rmsnorm(x, w+1.0) -> ScalarOffsetRmsNorm), which ships a BF16 gain in the mlx repacks; the `_s_<dtype>_` symbol must read it as bf16 (the f16 default mis-decodes -> garbled projection). The SigLIP block LayerNorms use the separate layer_norm_bias kernel (gain read as activation dtype), so this does not affect them. `vision_patch_embed_flatten.channels_last`: mlx_vlm-converted checkpoints store the SigLIP patch_embedding conv CHANNELS-LAST `[E, kh, kw, C]` (verified shape `[1152,14,14,3]`) while the pixel packing is channels-FIRST `(C, kh, kw)` (verified: scratchy pixels == mlx pixels at cos 1.0 in (c,kh,kw) order), so the weight is permuted to channels-first to match. HF-native Conv2d weights are already `[E,C,kh,kw]` and would need `false`; metal serves the mlx repacks. The fingerprint dim is 1 because the SigLIP->text projector matrix is `[vision_embed_dim, d_model]`.
